items.title: Viavi Surges 70% in the Past Year: Worth Including in Your Portfolio?
items.summary: Viavi Solutions (VIAV) has surged 69.7% over the past year, outperforming peers, driven by strong demand from AI data center infrastructure, aerospace and defense sector growth, and strategic acquisitions including Spirent Communications. The company's non-GAAP operating margin expanded to 29% in fiscal Q1, and management projects Q2 revenues of $505-$515 million. VIAV holds a Zacks Rank #1 (Strong Buy) rating.

items.title: VIAV's Q1 Beat and Q2 Outlook Highlight Data Center Momentum Ahead
items.summary: Viavi Solutions (VIAV) delivered robust fiscal Q1 2027 results with revenues surging 56.9% to $469.3 million and earnings jumping 213.3%, beating consensus estimates. The company projects Q2 revenues of $505-$515 million with continued strength from data-center demand, 1.6T optics, and semiconductor testing. Operating margins expanded significantly to 29%, supported by the Spirent acquisition and operating leverage.

items.title: VIAV Q1 Earnings Beat Estimates on Data Center, A&D Strength
items.summary: Viavi Solutions (VIAV) delivered robust Q1 FY2027 results with non-GAAP EPS of 47 cents (up 213.3% YoY) and revenues of $469.3 million (up 56.9% YoY), both beating consensus estimates. Strong demand from data centers, aerospace/defense markets, and acquired Spirent product lines drove growth. The company projects Q2 revenues of $505-515M and EPS of 50-52 cents, with expectations for continued sequential growth throughout fiscal 2027.
